target_customer: Insurers, MGAs and reinsurers seeking capital, and institutional investors seeking insurance risk returns
problem: Insurance risk portfolios were hard to securitize efficiently. Ledger built a marketplace and analytics so insurers could sell risk and institutions could invest in casualty insurance-linked securities.
business_model: Brokerage and advisory fees on securitizations through Ledger Capital Markets, plus asset management

founders.name: Samir Shah
founders.background_notes: Artemis reported in September 2016 that he would lead the start-up.

founders.name: Julien Brissonneau
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page as a founder in 2016.

founders.name: Aymeric Rabot
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page as a founder in 2016.

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard software plus actuarial and capital markets modeling; the hard part was structuring securitizations and building a broker-dealer.

defensibility.rationale: Broker-dealer licensing, relationships on both sides of the market and a track record of transactions are hard to replicate quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied or bought the company; Ledger kept growing independently through 2024 and handed fund management to Fermat Capital.

market_need_then: Insurers and MGAs wanted alternative capital while institutional investors sought uncorrelated returns; Artemis described the planned online marketplace in September 2016.

branding.domain_note: Uses ledgerinvesting.com, as the plain Ledger name belongs to a different crypto company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Institutional finance tone, Medium blog for community announcements

brand_strength.rationale: Strong inside insurance-linked securities trade press (Artemis, Reinsurance News) but searches for the name are crowded by the Ledger crypto wallet company.

outcome_analysis: Ledger Investing raised a 75M USD Series B in June 2022 and, per its own site, has securitized over 2.5 billion USD of casualty premium across 170 plus transactions. In 2024 it handed fund management to Fermat and launched Cayman subsidiaries. Niche focus on casualty ILS and licensing built a durable position.
notes: The January 2020 seed of 5M USD comes from a search summary of Artemis coverage and was not separately cross-checked, so treat as less certain; investors not stated. Total raised varies (CB Insights 95.92M, Caplight 90M). Series B is from OTPP release, FinSMEs and Ledger's Medium post. Several results were about the unrelated Ledger crypto company and were excluded. Founder prior employers and education were not found in opened sources (Medium and BusinessWire pages returned 403). Competitor searches returned no dated 2016 to 2017 rivals, so the list is empty.
